userStories.title: Scale CaptionRetryBudget max_attempts proportional to batch size

CaptionStage calls scale_to_batch_size() before starting batch fetch

userStories.title: Add budget exhaustion recovery with VPN rotation trigger
acceptanceCriteria: When budget exhausts due to >50% RATE_LIMIT errors, trigger VPN rotation if enabled
After VPN rotation, reset budget and retry remaining videos
Add `trigger_vpn_rotation_on_rate_limit: bool = True` config option
Limit VPN-triggered budget resets to max 2 per session to prevent loops
Log VPN rotation trigger: 'Budget exhausted with {rate_limit_pct}% rate limit errors, rotating VPN'
Integration test verifies VPN rotation resets budget (requires mock VPN)
userStories.notes: COMPLETE. Added get_rate_limit_error_percentage() method, should_trigger_vpn_rotation() method with >50% threshold check, record_vpn_reset() method, and can_vpn_reset() method to CaptionRetryBudget. Added trigger_vpn_on_rate_limit, max_vpn_resets, and vpn_resets_used fields. Config options added to CaptionRetryBudgetConfig in both src/caption/retry_budget.py and src/config/sections/download.py. Updated config.yaml with trigger_vpn_rotation_on_rate_limit and max_vpn_resets_per_session. Updated to_dict/from_dict for VPN state serialization. Updated reset() to preserve VPN count by default. Added 23 unit tests in TestCaptionRetryBudgetVPNRotationTrigger and TestCaptionRetryBudgetVPNRotationIntegration covering: rate limit percentage calculation, VPN rotation triggering conditions, config options, serialization, logging, and complete workflow. All 140 tests in test_caption_retry_budget.py pass.

userStories.title: Add early termination when success rate drops below threshold
acceptanceCriteria: Add `min_success_rate: float = 0.3` config option to CaptionRetryBudgetConfig
After processing 20+ videos, check if success rate < min_success_rate
If success rate too low, log warning and skip remaining videos gracefully
Add `early_terminated: bool` flag to budget state for checkpoint
BatchResult includes early_termination_reason when terminated
Unit test verifies early termination triggers at 20% success rate
userStories.notes: Tier: T2-Medium (optimization). Source files: src/caption/retry_budget.py, src/caption/batch_processor.py:446-558. When 80%+ of fetches fail, continuing wastes time. Early termination saves time while preserving successful fetches for matching.
